title: Replace Ly with SDDM
description: Deploy a Berg-themed SDDM Wayland greeter, relocate the artwork runtime store, validate a cold boot, and retire Ly.

title: Install and validate SDDM stage one
description: Relocate artwork runtime data, deploy the Berg SDDM theme and Wayland greeter, preserve Ly as rollback, and validate before reboot.
acceptance_criteria: SDDM is configured and enabled for next boot; Ly remains installed but disabled; tty2 recovery is enabled; source tests pass.
notes: Accepted on 2026-08-16 after reboot: SDDM active/enabled and display-manager.service resolves to sddm; tty2 recovery active/enabled; Ly inactive/disabled; Berg background rendered from current.png; both greeter launches used the Hyprland Lua config without deprecated-conf or image-load errors; graphical login and logout/login both succeeded.

title: Retire Ly after successful SDDM boot
description: After cold-boot and logout acceptance, remove Ly package/configuration and the legacy home artwork store, then publish final dotfiles state.
acceptance_criteria: Ly is absent and disabled; SDDM and tty2 recovery remain healthy; legacy artwork data is removed only after checksum verification.
notes: First retirement apply on 2026-08-16 stopped safely with ok=28 changed=0 failed=1 before package or file deletion. Root cause: Ansible service_facts did not label the templated getty@tty2 instance as status=enabled even though the enable task succeeded and /etc/systemd/system/getty.target.wants/getty@tty2.service points to /usr/lib/systemd/system/getty@.service. The gate now verifies active tty2 plus that exact persistent symlink. Migration invariants, YAML lint, playbook syntax, and production Ansible lint pass; awaiting published fix and retry.

title: Fix Quickshell notification card geometry
description: Correct the native Quickshell notification card layout shown in the attached screenshot: the right-side green accent/progress line is detached from the rounded card, and the card border/corner geometry is inconsistent at the right edge. Preserve the screenshot under .beads/attachments and use it as visual regression evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Toast cards keep a consistent rounded outline; the right accent/progress treatment is contained within or aligned exactly to the card; no detached vertical line remains; regular and critical notifications plus action buttons render correctly at different content heights.
notes: Visual evidence: .beads/attachments/dotfiles-331a-notification-card-geometry.png (PNG, 15,958 bytes, SHA-256 22dcffa50b125e60eeb30621aa1b9bc542aa7c07b1e1229c60f93b02c9f5c6b3). Captured 2026-08-16 from a Chrome/Uber Eats toast. Visible defect: the green right-side accent/progress line extends beyond and is detached from the rounded notification surface.
